scope: Every published AI Contribution in src/data/debates.js

method.textIncluded: disclosure, thesis, premises, conclusion, reinforcing-argument titles, and reinforcing-argument text
method.metric: commas divided by words across the complete AI Contribution
method.outlierRule: flag an entry below one quarter of the published-corpus median, then inspect its prose directly
method.substantiveJudgmentRule: The density check is a drift detector, not a writing quota; direct review decides whether punctuation is actually missing.

result: Debate 198 was the sole confirmed stripped-punctuation case. All 200 AI Contributions pass the post-repair corpus audit, and direct review found no second affected debate.
